captions.detailed: This 3D model features a fat bike front fork assembly with a wide aluminum-colored crown and thick, straight fork blades. At the top, a tapered, dark-colored head tube houses a steerer tube connected to a prominent stem and wide, flat black handlebars. The steering column is fully functional, rotating relative to the head tube via a revolute joint.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a fat bike fork assembly using CadQuery. The model should feature a wide metallic-grey fork with thick blades and a bottom axle, connected via a revolute steering joint inside a dark tapered head tube to a set of wide, flat black handlebars and stem.
captions.factory: The assembly is constructed by defining two main parts: the frame/head tube base and the rotating fork/handlebar steering assembly. The head tube is modeled using tapered cylinder primitives, while the fork is constructed from rectangular and cylindrical extrusions to form the crown, legs, and axle dropouts. The handlebars and stem are built using swept profiles or combined cylinders, and a revolute joint is established along the steering axis to connect the steering assembly to the head tube.
